idea-plugin.name: LaTeX Comments
idea-plugin.description:
Shows LaTeX maths in code comments as real formulas, right in the editor.

Write maths the way books print it and read it the same way: // $L = \sum_i (\phi_0 + \phi_1 x_i - y_i)^2$ shows as a typeset formula. The line under the caret shows the raw text, so editing stays easy.

  • $...$ and \(...\) inline, $$...$$ and \[...\] display maths (which may span several comment lines).
  • Line, block and documentation comments in C#, Java, Kotlin, C and C++, Python, JavaScript and TypeScript, Go, Rust, F#, Scala, Swift, R, Julia, Lua, SQL, MATLAB and more.
  • Hover over a formula for a larger preview; formulas also show in Quick Documentation for Java and Kotlin.
  • Turn it on or off from View or the editor's right-click menu; formula size in Settings | Tools | LaTeX Comments.
  • Sharp on scaled screens and in light and dark themes. Mistakes in the LaTeX show as a short note, never an error.

Formulas are drawn by JLaTeXMath (GPL 2 with the classpath exception). The plugin makes no network connections. MIT licence.

action.description: Show LaTeX maths in comments as formulas, or as plain text
